A LITTLE GUIDANCE

Let your thoughts branch.

Click a card and start writing. Click outside it to see your Markdown come to life.

↓ Same column
Add the next thought with the + below a card. The + on a vertical line makes room in between.
→ Next column
Use the + to the right of a card to add its first child. Add more children with the + above or below that child.
↕ Make room
Drag the handle at the top of a card to reorder it within its column. Its children travel with it.
↳ Open a draft
The folder opens a Markdown file. Heading levels become columns, and each heading starts a card. New starts with one blank card. Undo restores the previous draft.
↗ Take it with you
Export reads a card, then its children, then the next sibling. Your Markdown stays intact.
